text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"What I run on is a racetrack,
not a predetermined track."

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: "So I'll probably keep giving you tons to worry about from here on out!"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"Even so...
Just say it with a straight face today."

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Telling me to "go out there and have fun"...!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Watch closely and see how Ace lives her life!
